title: Raj Yoga explained: what it really means in your chart | Ask Tota
description: A raj yoga is a kendra lord connected to a trikona lord. Here is how they form, why almost every chart has one, and what actually decides whether a yoga delivers anything.
og_title: Raj yoga, and why urs probably isn't rare
og_description: A kendra lord meeting a trikona lord. That is the whole rule. Here is how raj yogas form, how common they are, and what makes one actually deliver.
h1: raj yoga is a handshake between two houses
dek: a lord of a kendra connecting with a lord of a trikona. that is the entire definition, and it is far more common than the word raj suggests. here is how the main yogas form, how often, and the four things that decide whether one ever does anything for u.

faq.q: what is raj yoga in vedic astrology?
faq.a: a connection between the lord of a kendra house (1, 4, 7, 10) and the lord of a trikona house (1, 5, 9). the connection can be a conjunction, a mutual aspect, or an exchange of signs.

faq.q: does raj yoga mean i will be rich or famous?
faq.a: no. the name comes from raja, king, and the classical descriptions are written in the language of courts. in practice a raj yoga marks a place where structure and fortune support each other, which is a starting condition rather than an outcome.

very. kendras and trikonas cover seven of the twelve houses and share the 1st, so the pool of lords that could connect is large. most charts have at least one raj yoga somewhere, which is exactly why the label alone tells u so little.

a single graha that rules both a kendra and a trikona for ur lagna, so it forms a raj yoga on its own. only six lagnas get one: saturn for vrishabha and tula, mars for karka and simha, venus for makara and kumbha.
the 9th lord and the 10th lord connected. the 9th is dharma and the 10th is karma, so the tradition treats it as the strongest of the raj yogas: what u believe lining up with what u do for a living.
jupiter in a kendra from the moon, meaning the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th sign counted from ur moon sign. that is four of twelve possible positions, so it occurs in roughly one chart in three.

faq.q: what are the panch mahapurusha yogas?
faq.a: five yogas formed when mars, mercury, jupiter, venus or saturn sits in its own sign or exaltation sign, in a kendra from the lagna. ruchaka is mars, bhadra mercury, hamsa jupiter, malavya venus, sasa saturn.

a yoga formed when the lords of the difficult houses (6, 8, 12) connect with each other rather than with the good houses. the reading is that trouble contains itself. the three named forms are harsha, sarala and vimala.

faq.q: what is neecha bhanga raja yoga?
faq.a: the cancellation of a debilitated planet's weakness, usually because the lord of its sign of debilitation or the lord of its exaltation sign is well placed. it is read as a weakness that turns into a strength, and the rules for it vary between texts.

faq.q: why has my raj yoga not done anything?
faq.a: usually timing. a yoga is described as delivering during the dasha periods of the grahas forming it. if those periods fall in childhood or very late in life, the yoga is present in the chart and quiet in the life.

faq.q: can a raj yoga be cancelled?
faq.a: it can be weakened. the usual reasons are the participating grahas being debilitated, combust, badly placed, or also ruling the 6th, 8th or 12th house. the tradition calls this a broken or blemished yoga rather than a cancelled one.

faq.q: how do i find my raj yogas?
faq.a: list the lords of houses 1, 4, 7 and 10, and the lords of 1, 5 and 9. then check whether any kendra lord and any trikona lord sit together, aspect each other, or have swapped signs. that is the whole search.
